title: Pinnacle Financial Partners Inc. Has $16.09 Million Holdings in Apple (AAPL)

text:
Posted by Nicole Wilson on Mar 24th, 2018 // No Comments 
Pinnacle Financial Partners Inc. raised its stake in Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 8.6% during the fourth quarter, according to its most recent disclosure with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). The fund owned 95,056 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after buying an additional 7,508 shares during the quarter. Apple comprises about 1.7% of Pinnacle Financial Partners Inc.’s portfolio, making the stock its 7th biggest holding. Pinnacle Financial Partners Inc.’s holdings in Apple were worth $16,086,000 as of its most recent filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). 
A number of other hedge funds and other institutional investors also recently bought and sold shares of the business. Mitchell Capital Management Co. lifted its position in shares of Apple by 3.6% during the second quarter. Mitchell Capital Management Co. now owns 2,831 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $408,000 after purchasing an additional 98 shares in the last quarter. CIBC Asset Management Inc raised its holdings in Apple by 2.2% in the second quarter. CIBC Asset Management Inc now owns 746,619 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $107,528,000 after acquiring an additional 16,031 shares in the last quarter. Silicon Valley Capital Partners raised its holdings in Apple by 0.5% in the second quarter. Silicon Valley Capital Partners now owns 28,693 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $4,132,000 after acquiring an additional 134 shares in the last quarter. Heritage Wealth Advisors raised its holdings in Apple by 9.4% in the second quarter. Heritage Wealth Advisors now owns 18,186 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $2,619,000 after acquiring an additional 1,568 shares in the last quarter. Finally, Lourd Capital LLC raised its holdings in Apple by 4.1% in the second quarter. Lourd Capital LLC now owns 34,297 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $4,939,000 after acquiring an additional 1,366 shares in the last quarter. 61.33% of the stock is currently owned by institutional investors. Several analysts recently weighed in on the stock. Bank of America reaffirmed a “buy” rating and issued a $220.00 target price on shares of Apple in a report on Friday. Vetr raised shares of Apple from a “buy” rating to a “strong-buy” rating and set a $191.57 target price on the stock in a report on Friday. Nomura reaffirmed a “neutral” rating and issued a $175.00 target price on shares of Apple in a report on Monday, March 19th. Rosenblatt Securities reaffirmed a “buy” rating and issued a $180.00 target price on shares of Apple in a report on Friday, March 16th. Finally, Barclays reduced their target price on shares of Apple from $170.00 to $168.00 and set an “equal weight” rating on the stock in a report on Friday, March 16th. One investment analyst has rated the stock with a sell rating, seventeen have issued a hold rating, thirty-two have given a buy rating and two have issued a strong buy rating to the company. The company has a consensus rating of “Buy” and an average price target of $201.69. 
In other news, insider Daniel J. Riccio sold 15,641 shares of Apple stock in a transaction on Friday, January 5th. The stock was sold at an average price of $174.78, for a total transaction of $2,733,733.98. Following the completion of the transaction, the insider now owns 13,739 shares of the company’s stock, valued at approximately $2,401,302.42. The transaction was disclosed in a filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which is available at this link . Insiders own 0.08% of the company’s stock. 
AAPL stock traded down $3.91 during trading hours on Friday, hitting $164.94. The stock had a trading volume of 40,248,954 shares, compared to its average volume of 33,141,388. The firm has a market cap of $856,747.19, a P/E ratio of 16.95, a PEG ratio of 1.28 and a beta of 1.19. The company has a quick ratio of 1.20, a current ratio of 1.24 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.74. Apple has a fifty-two week low of $138.62 and a fifty-two week high of $183.50. 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last released its quarterly earnings results on Thursday, February 1st. The iPhone maker reported $3.89 earnings per share (EPS) for the quarter, topping the consensus estimate of $3.82 by $0.07. The business had revenue of $88.29 billion during the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $87.62 billion. Apple had a return on equity of 37.37% and a net margin of 21.13%. The business’s revenue was up 12.7% on a year-over-year basis. During the same quarter in the previous year, the company posted $3.36 EPS. equities analysts forecast that Apple will post 11.4 EPS for the current year.
